text: PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 1:58 of Block 01, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 830076, situated in the Village of Sandagiripura, within the Grama Niladhari Division of 10 - Sandagiripura in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Thissamaharamaya, in the District of Hambanthota, in the Province of Southern, referred to in Notice calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2315/36 of 19th January, 2023 in terms of Section 55 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P. C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 07th October, 2024.
